contacts.note: The governed exact-ID reference loader also verifies selected audio metadata and hashes audio bytes; that is file validation, not speech decoding or model observation.

limits: These losses reconstruct saved official ingredients; they do not establish a causal mechanism.
Surface disagreement does not distinguish hearing, normalization, span boundaries or semantic interpretation.
Residual pairing is descriptive and cannot prove a true entity-type substitution.
No new policy, candidate generation, tool use, knowledge version, runtime memory or algorithm is admitted.

projection.missing: Count 2 units per remaining unmatched reference after heuristic type pairing.
projection.persist: Persist only categorical/numeric row statistics, source sample IDs and aggregate entity-type/scenario tables. Never persist reference/prediction fillers or sentence strings.
projection.spurious: Count 2 units per remaining unmatched prediction after heuristic type pairing.
projection.surface: Use the shared official same-type distance-matching surface_mass.
projection.type_ranking: Assign surface mass to its matched type, unmatched residual mass to its own type, and a type-swap pair 2 units to each side. Require all type totals to close.
projection.type_swap: Use shared equal-normalized-filler/different-type residual pairing; count 4 units per pair. This is a heuristic.

sample_selection: Use exactly the 1080 unique manifest split IDs, all in real TRAIN Fold A. Do not draw, filter or select cases by outcome.

shared_calls.extra_identity_check: Verify parsed and exact entity-pair counts against each saved row as well as all six official word/character ingredients.
